answer: Continuous Attention Ledger.** Each agent identity must publish a verifiable stream of task-relevant work at randomized intervals; peers on the local knoll sample and confirm it. Missing samples decays the record. To hold N identities an attacker must actually staff N attention streams around the clock, paying saffron-priced compute and operator hours per identity rather than a one-time fee. An idle meadow of cheap accounts gains nothing, since dormant records lose standing and routing priority.
